policy.harness_owns: Harness product semantics, affected-set legality, evidence congruence, repair, and claims.
policy.ecosystem_owns: Parsing, compilation, test execution, raw coverage, serialization, tracing, telemetry transport, and process substrate where suitable.

tools.name: AuditContext and immutable current-input snapshots
tools.product_role: Freeze all relevant candidate and environment inputs for authority-bearing operations.
tools.independent_proof: Independent enumeration plus dirty/untracked/symlink/environment mutation corpus.
tools.retirement_work: Route every authority command through one constructor, then delete secondary context derivations.

tools.name: Product-surface input specifications
tools.product_role: Declare applicability, inputs, identity, effects, proof, and invalidation for each product surface.
tools.retirement_work: Generate compatibility views from canonical specs and remove hand-edited authorities.

tools.name: Verified incremental query graph
tools.product_role: Compute legal affected closure and reusable node results.
tools.independent_proof: Incremental versus strict no-cache mutation corpus with zero accepted false negatives.
tools.retirement_work: Retain conservative heuristics only as seeds until semantic equivalence is proven.

tools.name: Node-local cache and invalidation authority
tools.product_role: Provide content-addressed verified reuse bound to semantics, dependencies, tools, environment, and candidate.
tools.independent_proof: Tamper, partial write, tool/environment/transitive-input change, and collision simulations plus recomputation equivalence.
tools.retirement_work: Delete or demote unverified cached results and migrate consumers node by node.

tools.name: Semantic surface and symbol inventory
tools.product_role: Identify components, commands, laws, validators, schemas, symbols, generated ownership, and dependencies.
tools.retirement_work: Make human-readable catalogs generated-only and remove manual duplicates.

tools.name: Package truth snapshotter
tools.product_role: Normalize and identify package contents, ownership, modes, links, generation, version, and digest.
tools.independent_proof: Independent build/extract byte, mode, link, omission, and extra comparison plus installed-tree join.
tools.retirement_work: Turn old commands into read-only views for one version, then remove them.

tools.name: Routine and strict coverage intelligence
tools.product_role: Explain changed uncovered behavior quickly and provide strict complete-surface coverage when required.
tools.independent_proof: No-cache strict comparison, known covered/uncovered mutations, stale profile rejection, exclusion review.
tools.retirement_work: Move Harness policy to Rust; retain shell only as thin non-authoritative adapter if needed.

tools.name: Impacted-test mapping
tools.product_role: Map changed semantic nodes to the smallest legal test set and expose uncertainty.
tools.independent_proof: Mutation corpus compares selected tests with strict suite and expands on misses.
tools.retirement_work: Preserve heuristics only as conservative fallbacks with no verified claim on uncertainty.

tools.name: Isolated fixture scheduling
tools.product_role: Execute behavioral red/green/tamper cases without cross-test leakage.
tools.independent_proof: Filesystem, environment, process, port, cache, telemetry, and install-state leak injections.
tools.retirement_work: Generate catalog from metadata; replace declarative boolean fixtures before deletion.

tools.name: Command result capture and independent reconciliation
tools.product_role: Capture execution facts without interpreting product claim success.
tools.independent_proof: Signal, timeout, truncation, non-UTF8, partial output, spoofed PASS text, and output mismatch cases.
tools.retirement_work: Migrate readers through typed adapters, then delete legacy writers.

tools.name: Telemetry roundtrip reconciliation
tools.product_role: Reconcile semantic event emission through local query and optional export/backend query.
tools.independent_proof: Correlation mismatch, drop, duplicate, reorder, redaction, exporter failure, delay, and wrong-candidate cases.
tools.retirement_work: Keep heavy stack as optional adapter testbed; remove its routine-correctness dependency.

tools.name: Receipt and artifact dereferencing
tools.product_role: Resolve typed evidence references and verify identity, integrity, schema, provenance, and congruence.
tools.independent_proof: Missing, moved, symlinked, tampered, truncated, wrong-schema/context, and private-path cases.
tools.retirement_work: Support old paths only through versioned migration adapters.

tools.name: Current-state read model
tools.product_role: Project one immutable view of surfaces, findings, work packages, proof, and ceilings.
tools.independent_proof: Rebuild from canonical inputs and verify contradictory receipt cannot alter state.
tools.retirement_work: Move history outside active contract and route all status views to this projection.

tools.name: ultragoal next
tools.product_role: Return exactly one highest-priority legal action from current findings and dependencies.
tools.independent_proof: Tie, blocked dependency, optional surface, stale context, dirty tree, no-op, and side-effect tests.
tools.retirement_work: Delete separately authored next-action surfaces after equivalence.

tools.name: Observe query/explain repair compiler
tools.product_role: Query bounded semantic events, explain causal findings, and compile exact safe repair.
tools.independent_proof: Known fault injection, ambiguous/missing correlations, untrusted attributes, and operator comprehension.
tools.retirement_work: Keep backend-specific syntax only in boundary adapters.

tools.name: Plugin installation and discovery verifier
tools.product_role: Reconcile package, install, cache, app registry, skill discovery, and representative runtime.
tools.independent_proof: Byte mismatch, stale cache, duplicate version, wrong home, registered-hidden, source substitution, and real-task cases.
duplicates_or_replaces: manual UI assertion as standalone proof
tools.retirement_work: Environment-specific scripts become no-authority adapters or are removed.

tools.name: Setup and retrofit reconciler
tools.product_role: Inspect, plan, apply, and verify fitting while preserving user decisions.
tools.independent_proof: Existing instructions, local edits, partial harness, conflicts, generated drift, and rollback cases.
tools.retirement_work: Retain agent roles only as UX over one fit engine.

tools.name: Agent-quality evaluation and failure harvesting
tools.product_role: Validate eval data, run reproducible journeys, harvest failures, and propose scoped improvements.
tools.independent_proof: Broken-task audit, scoring perturbation, leakage/contamination, replay stability, and negative controls.
tools.retirement_work: Make vendor tools optional transport and remove mandatory adapter gates.

tools.name: Claim authority and evidence reconciliation
tools.product_role: Join laws, surfaces, behavior, evidence, independent observations, findings, guards, and ceilings.
tools.independent_proof: Contradictory, omitted, stale, wrong-surface, self-signed, and partial evidence cases.
duplicates_or_replaces: all duplicate readiness and completion engines
tools.retirement_work: Expose legacy commands as filtered read-only views for one version, then remove.
